summary: Wrote a 5-phase plan applying research decision (i): delete all four MCP write-tool grants from the sapience settings-fragment, leaving the seven read-shaped entries. Plan sizing found four coupled surfaces the research report missed -- verify-sapience-mcp.sh hardcodes the grant count as `-eq 11` and would report failure against a correct narrowing, permission-configuration.md names the sapience worked example by name, and manifest.json plus index-entries.json both state the 11-grant figure. Phases 1-4 land the narrowing and the prose reconciliation; Phase 5 folds in the merge-source and metadata edits, redeploys, and verifies the fresh-load acceptance criterion. All three Carried-Figure premises were re-validated against live state and confirmed unchanged.
